title: Sunday · a third of a page
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The papers cut the Sunday to a third of a page. The strip is drawn to the smaller grid. The reader can measure it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach in May, wet-on-wet — but the whole page is drawn inside a box occupying the top third of the sheet; the bottom two-thirds is blank paper. Three tiers crammed into the third.

image.prompt: a Sunday comic page where all three tiers are crammed into the top third of the sheet and the lower two-thirds is left as blank white paper, the tiers showing a beach in May in wet-on-wet watercolor with a man and a three-legged dog, small
image.notes: The whole Sunday in the top third. The blank is the point. Print it that way.

panels.name: Cramped

panels.composition: Tier 2, tiny: the pup at the surf. Detail lost to size.

image.prompt: a tiny tier of a three-legged dog at a surf line, watercolor, details lost to the small size

panels.name: Tiny

panels.composition: Tier 3, tiny: the drift log, the two of them. The mark in the margin drawn smaller than it's ever been.

image.prompt: a tiny tier of a man and a dog on a drift log, watercolor, cramped, the signature mark in the margin drawn very small

panels.name: The log

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Drawn to the papers' cut. Two-thirds blank. The mark shrinks.
